meta.name: get-qodo-rules
meta.description: Loads org- and repo-level coding rules from Qodo before code tasks begin, ensuring all generation and modification follows team standards. Use before any code generation or modification task when rules are not already loaded. Invoke when user asks to write, edit, refactor, or review code, or when starting implementation planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 加载团队编码规则，确保代码符合规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队有编码规则需要自动遵守
copy.tagline_en: Load team coding rules to ensure code compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team has coding rules to enforce automatically

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在写或改代码前会先从 Qodo 平台拉取仓库编码规则(如安全、质量标准),按严重程度强制或建议遵守,并在生成后汇报应用情况。
howto.when: 当用户要求写、编辑、重构或审查代码,或开始实施规划时触发;如果对话里已有“Qodo Rules Loaded”则跳过。

say.text: 写代码前先加载 Qodo 规则,按规则来。
say.note: Claude 会检查仓库并拉取规则。

say.text: 重构这个模块,注意 Qodo 的 ERROR 规则。
say.note: 会加上合规注释并遵守。

say.text: 审查代码时应用 Qodo 规则,并报告哪些规则适用。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude fetches repo-specific coding rules from Qodo before writing or modifying code, applies them by severity (ERROR must comply, WARNING should, RECOMMENDATION consider), and reports which rules were applied.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks to write, edit, refactor, or review code, or starts implementation planning; skipped if "Qodo Rules Loaded" is in context.

say_en.text: Load Qodo rules before writing code and follow them.
Refactor this module respecting Qodo ERROR rules.
Apply Qodo rules when reviewing code and report.
